description: TexturePainting multi-texture atlas mutation audit with asymmetrical base-color RGB oracle.

mutants.description: Each stacked texture must retain its own vertical atlas region.
Decoded texture pixels must be copied into the atlas before sampling.
A valid per-material texture mapping must select the mapped texture instead of a base-color fallback.

mutants.old:
const float u_atlas = (x_off + u * std::max(0, tw - 1)) /
                                      static_cast<float>(std::max(1, atlas_w - 1));
mutants.new:
const float u_atlas = (x_off + u * atlas_w) /
                                      static_cast<float>(std::max(1, atlas_w - 1));
mutants.description: Horizontal atlas UVs must use the selected sub-texture's pixel extent, not the full atlas width.

mutants.old:
const float v_atlas = (y_off + v * std::max(0, th - 1)) /
                                      static_cast<float>(std::max(1, atlas_h - 1));
mutants.new:
const float v_atlas = (y_off + v * atlas_h) /
                                      static_cast<float>(std::max(1, atlas_h - 1));
mutants.description: Vertical atlas UVs must use the selected sub-texture's pixel extent, not the full atlas height.

mutants.old: const float v_atlas = y_off / static_cast<float>(std::max(1, atlas_h - 1));
mutants.description: A base-color swatch must sample its own row rather than a neighboring texture or guard row.
RGBA material colors must be written into OpenCV's BGR atlas representation without swapping red and blue.
Each untextured material needs a distinct swatch row and must not overwrite a texture row.
Material-less faces use the first decoded texture as the documented legacy fallback.
Texture tiling coordinates must be wrapped before remapping into the atlas.
Encoded PNG inputs carry channels in their byte stream and must reach decoding before raw-pixel channel validation.
